brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: The build is one Hex base · North half (piece at q0,r0,level0). No other bases, covers, caps or props were added. check_build reports meshClash clear; the only info is OPEN_CAP_FACE, which I left unaddressed since the brief forbids adding anything.

Drawers attach only to the cut face of a half base, and this base has one cut face. The configurator offered exactly one drawer slot (addDrawer key 's'), and after placing it no further drawer offers existed. The build holds one drawer (drawer:0#0,0#cut). The full base offers no drawer slots at all. Five drawers would need more cut faces or more bases, which the brief excludes.

finish.summary: The build is a single Hex base · North half with one drawer on its cut face. The single-base requirement is met. The five-drawer requirement is not: the configurator allows only one drawer per half base, and adding bases to get more would break the single-base requirement.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
